name: Armin Morov
description: The human pontiff in the Orzhov triumvirate.

description_citations.text: "Araithia Shokta". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
timeline.quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Chief Enforcer Bilagru offers his enforcers and the Syndicate's military to protect Orzhov investments from the Eternals, and Kaya threatens to forgive all debts.
timeline.quote: I can render all debt collection moot, by forgiving every single debt this instant.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A very old human pontiff and Orzhov Triumvirate member who evades Kaya's call to fight.
